messages:
mike_csm: Quick update — sending the welcome kit to the Nimbus beta cohort at 3pm PT. Need one final pass on the enablement schedule and the short feedback survey. tagging laura_cs + sam_eng for content and eng availability. link to draft: https://redwood-internal/drive/nimbus-kit (internal)
laura_cs: On it. I'll check the one-pager and add a step-by-step for GA handoff. Do we have an enablement session date? :calendar:
sam_eng: We can do a 30-min tech walkthrough on Tue 10am PT. I can cover model variant mapping and rollout opt-in. Are we planning a canary? :thinking_face:
mike_csm: Yes — canary for first 10 accounts, then 50% roll after 48h. Need the doc updated with canary criteria (error rate, latency delta, regen rate). I'll paste the thresholds.
mike_csm: ```Canary thresholds:
- 95th p99 latency < 400ms
- Error rate < 0.5%
- Response quality regression < 2% (from eval suite)
```laura_cs: Nice. For surveying, shorter is better. Proposed 5 q's: onboarding ease, docs clarity, latency experience, suggestion box, willingness to renew. Should we include a CS-NPS prompt?
mike_csm: Keep NPS optional. We'll ask "likelihood to recommend" but not make it gate.
andrews_ops: deploy-bot noted scheduled send at 2024-11-12T15:00Z — will attach tracking tags: cohort=nimbus, flow=welcome_kit
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Scheduled message send + UTM tags. Attachment will include short checklist and survey link.
laura_cs: Added the step-by-step and a short troubleshooting FAQ. Shared doc updated.
sam_eng: Confirmed availability Tue 10am PT. Also added a short slide on model fallback behavior and what to expect during canary.
mike_csm: Awesome. Last thing — can someone own post-onboard check-in at day 7? I'll take day 1 and 3. Who can do day 7 and 21?
laura_cs: I'll take day 7. I can run a quick health pulse and collect logs for any issues.
sam_eng: I'll do day 21 for technical follow-up and possible tuning suggestions.
mike_csm: Perfect. I'll send a calendar invite and the survey link. Thanks team :raised_hands:
laura_cs: :thumbsup:
sam_eng: :thumbsup:
